answer.reason: The verses tell of Barak's campaign against Sisera, giving two chief events beyond what the summary states.

clauses.english: went up to Mount Tabor with ten thousand men at Deborah's call
clauses.quote: he went up with ten thousand men at his feet

clauses.english: pursued Sisera's host to Harosheth, and all of it fell by the sword
clauses.quote: all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword

doubts: JDG 5:1, JDG 5:12 and JDG 5:15 (song) and 1SA 12:11 and HEB 11:32 were not used; 1SA 12:11 names Bedan, possibly Barak, but this is uncertain, and the song and Hebrews add nothing beyond the narrative.
